name: Dragon Aura
description: Royal Dragon lineage: grants +10% Hit and +10% Avoid to allies within 2 tiles.

name: Hidden Potential
description: Permanently increases all six stat growth rates (HP, Atk, Def, SpA, SpD, Spe) by +20%.

name: Levitate
description: Grants Levitate omni-traversal across Void, Lava, Water, Trees, and Mountains at 1 Mov cost.

name: Overgrow
description: Grants +3 Damage with Grass-type moves when current HP is at or below 50%.

name: Blaze
description: Grants +3 Damage with Fire-type moves when current HP is at or below 50%.

name: Torrent
description: Grants +3 Damage with Water-type moves when current HP is at or below 50%.

name: Swarm
description: Grants +3 Damage with Bug-type moves when current HP is at or below 50%.

name: Intimidate
description: At the start of Player Phase, inflicts -2 Attack for 1 turn on enemies within 2 tiles.

name: Guts
description: Grants +3 Attack while afflicted with a Status Condition and ignores Burn's Attack reduction.

name: Sturdy
description: Once per battle, if at 100% HP and dealt lethal damage, survives with 1 HP.

name: Stance Change
description: Grants +4 Def / +4 SpD on Enemy Phase (Shield Forme) and +4 Atk / +4 SpA on Player Phase (Blade Forme).

name: Supreme Overlord
description: Grants +1 Atk, +1 Def, and +1 SpD for each defeated royal guard squad on the map (up to +5).

name: Serene Grace
description: Doubles the trigger chance of random secondary effects on moves.

name: Natural Cure
description: Automatically cures non-volatile Status Conditions at the end of the unit's turn.

name: Flower Veil
description: Grants +2 Sp. Def and +10% Avoid when standing on Trees/Foliage or Wonder Tiles.

name: Queenly Majesty
description: Grants +2 Attack and +10% Hit when initiating combat on Player Phase.

name: Magic Bounce
description: Grants +2 Sp. Def and immunity to non-damaging enemy Status moves.

name: Tinted Lens
description: Boosts Not Very Effective (0.75x) attacks up to neutral (1.0x) damage.

name: Keen Eye
description: Increases the unit's Hit Rate (Accuracy) by +15% in all combat.

name: Mirror Armor
description: Grants +2 Defense and prevents enemy attacks from lowering this unit's stats.

name: Synchronize
description: Grants +2 Sp. Atk and +10% Avoid against Range 2 Special attacks.

name: Magic Guard
description: Negates all indirect damage from Poison, Burn, Lava, and Life Orb recoil.

name: Static
description: Grants +10% Crit with Electric moves and a 25% chance to Paralyze Range-1 attackers.

name: Defiant
description: Grants +3 Attack whenever current HP is below 75% or a stat is lowered.

name: Purifying Salt
description: Immune to all Status Conditions and reduces incoming Ghost-type damage by 3.

name: Solid Rock
description: Reduces incoming Super Effective and Extremely Effective damage by 2.

name: Swift Swim
description: Grants +2 Speed and +10% Avoid when fighting on Water or Dungeon Floor tiles.

name: Chlorophyll
description: Grants +2 Speed and +10% Hit when standing on Trees/Foliage tiles.

name: Flame Body
description: Grants +2 Sp. Atk on Fire moves and a 25% chance to Burn Range-1 attackers.

name: Mold Breaker
description: Grants +2 Physical damage and pierces enemy Sturdy.

name: Clear Body
description: Grants +1 Defense, +1 Sp. Def, and complete immunity to stat reductions.

name: Huge Power
description: Increases Attack by +3 when using Physical (Range 1) moves.

name: Pixie Ward
description: Reduces damage taken from Physical (Range 1) attacks by 2.

name: Screen Cleaner
description: Grants +10% Hit and pierces enemy Reflect, Light Screen, and Obstruct.

name: Ice Body
description: Restores 10% Max HP at the start of Player Phase and grants +1 Defense.

name: Adaptability
description: Boosts Same-Type Attack Bonus (STAB) damage by +2.

name: Thick Fat
description: Reduces incoming Fire-type and Ice-type move damage by 3.

name: Resonant Voice
description: Grants +2 Sp. Atk on Range-2 attacks and +2 Sp. Def when defending at Range 2.

name: Sand Stream
description: Grants +2 Sp. Def and +1 Attack in rocky and subterranean terrain.

name: Sheer Force
description: Grants +2 Damage when using any move that carries a secondary effect.

name: Water Absorb
description: Immune to Water-type damage and restores 25% Max HP if targeted by a Water move.

name: Volt Absorb
description: Immune to Electric-type damage and grants +2 Speed.

name: Flash Fire
description: Immune to Fire-type damage and grants +2 Damage with Fire moves.

name: Pressure
description: Grants +2 Def / +2 Sp. Def on Enemy Phase and drains +1 extra PP from attackers.

name: Prankster
description: Grants +15% Hit on Status/Support moves and +10% Avoid.

name: Shadow Tag
description: Grants +2 Sp. Atk and +10% Hit against enemies within 2 tiles.

name: No Guard
description: Ensures 100% Hit accuracy for this unit's attacks and grants +1 Attack.
